titulo: Neonatal unilateral testicular torsion in the first 16 hours of life

fig.label: Figure 1.
fig.caption: (A) Scrotal ultrasound demonstrated an enlarged testis with a markedly heterogeneous echotexture and absence of intratesticular blood flow on Color Doppler, consistent with neonatal extravaginal testicular torsion. (B) Color Doppler ultrasound revealed complete absence of intratesticular blood flow in the affected testis, confirming acute ischemia secondary to neonatal extravaginal testicular torsion.
